entry_before.title_zh: 知识与生活：相连的哲学候选
entry_before.title_en: Knowing and living: connected philosophical proposal
entry_before.claim_zh: 认识、纠正与模型修订构成相连候选。G0下意识分化生的意义，新的生也可有正面意义且不自动产生特定义务。保存已有生活能够要求实际更新；更强争点是超出既有请求与保存目标的新实现。整体改名不能隐去毁损，拒绝福利性创造理由不等于否定全部生成根据。 有条件的照护不独自穷尽生成理由，排除其他正面根据须另有辩护。 完整历史中的混合改善与正当重新分配可导出新的生的正面比较；先后评价须有明确传递。 完整排序不是基本正面意义的新增门槛；新生的正面理由与具体行动要求分别说明。 生的意义不以调节成功或自足为门槛；依存中的生活与局部成功的整体后果分别保留。 意识比较完成两问：福利限制不独自穷尽伦理意义，感觉改变须重评，不能自动保留或抹去全部价值。 探究目的检验区分正确性、探究理由与更广生活根据；理解可以本身值得实现，但使用科学不独自驳倒对 G0 的范围限制。 共同生活根据检验说明 G0 与 J1/J4 能在无反向损失且正当可行时支持非意识生活的继续；条件性选择差异不反过来证明公理。 理由权威检验即使承认客观实践理由，仍须解释其具体内容为何涵盖 G0 的生的范围；保留目的修订及可错纠正的正面账户。
entry_before.claim_en: Knowing, correction and model revision form a connected account. Under G0, consciousness differentiates living significance and new living can count positively without assigning a specific duty. Preservation can require renewal; the sharper dispute concerns new realization beyond incumbent claims and preservation targets. Redescription cannot erase destruction, and rejecting a welfare-based creation reason does not reject every generative ground. Conditional care does not independently exhaust formation reasons; excluding a further favorable ground needs its own defense. Whole-history mixed improvement and warranted reallocation yield favorable formation; stage-relative judgments need explicit transport. A complete ordering is not an additional gate for basic positive significance; favorable formation reasons and practical requirements retain distinct grounds. Living significance is not awarded for regulatory success or self-sufficiency; dependent living and the whole consequences of local success remain in view. The consciousness comparison closes the two questions: a welfare restriction alone does not exhaust ethical significance, and changed feeling requires reassessment without automatic retention or erasure of all value. The inquiry-purpose test distinguishes correctness, reasons to inquire and wider living grounds; understanding can itself be worth realizing, but using science alone does not refute a restriction of G0. The common-living-ground test shows how G0/J1/J4 can favor nonconscious living continuation under no-loss and legitimate-feasibility conditions; that conditional difference does not prove the axiom. The reason-authority test grants objective practical reasons while requiring an explanation of why their content reaches G0 living scope; purpose revision and fallible correction retain their positive roles.
entry_before.scope_zh: 两个范围问题在G0/J下的完成保留；扩读Frick的接续价值论，新增Finneron-Burns原典检验保存对象的界定，纠正过粗的对手归类。无新定理、实验或独立验收；整套理论必要性、最广组织范围及普遍意识／语义仍未证。继承界面相容8／11、一般相容13／18、模型修订30／72及76次执行、来源26／53、选择性修订16／32与四项统计复核原范围；完成的实践与对齐方向不重开。 新增Aaron原典批评与作者反审，信用既有时间与排序分析；批评限制不等于证明相反公理。 生成序列新增6项Lean定理／13项空依赖审计；有限诊断只检验较弱推论，不证明完整对手或G0。 本轮Chappell与Dorr–Nebel–Zuehl原典检验强化正面论证与实质反审；两个G0回答保持完成，无新定理、编译或实验，普遍必要性仍未证。 Bruckner与Dussault原典及依存反审强化非感知范围候选，不把充分根据误作必要条件；无新证明或普遍必要性结论。 Cecchinato、Gottlieb等与Shepherd原典评估保留 G0/J/E 的明确根据；有心灵不等于涵盖全部生命，无新证明或整套理论必要性结论。 Friedman与Kauppinen原典比较保留认识规范及非工具认知价值；共同伦理根据仍需跨范围辩护，无新证明或普遍必要性结论。 Goodpaster与Benatar原典比较保留生物利益与独立伦理根据的分歧；两个回答已完成，整套理论的科学必要性未证，无新定理或实验。 Vesper与McPherson/Plunkett原典比较区分实践必要性、认识根据与具体伦理内容；没有新增规范存在证明、G0必然性或数学定理。
entry_before.scope_en: The two G0/J scope answers remain complete. Extended Frick reading and a new Finneron-Burns comparison sharpen the preservation target and correct an overly broad rival classification. No new theorem, experiment or independent acceptance. Whole-theory necessity, the broadest organizational scope and universal consciousness/semantics remain unproved. Inherited profile compatibility 8/11, general compatibility 13/18, model revision 30/72 and 76 runs, source reliance 26/53, selective revision 16/32 and four-statistic checks retain their scopes; completed practical and alignment arguments are reused. New Aaron primary criticism and author counterreview credit the prior temporal and ordering analyses; criticism of a restriction does not prove the opposite axiom. Formation sequence adds 6 Lean theorems/13 empty dependency audits; the finite diagnostic tests a weaker inference, not a full ethical rival or G0. This round’s Chappell and Dorr–Nebel–Zuehl primary assessments strengthen the affirmative argument and substantive counterreview; the two G0 answers remain complete, with no new theorem, compilation or experiment and no universal-necessity proof. Bruckner and Dussault primary assessments and the dependence counterreview strengthen the nonsentient-scope candidate without confusing sufficient grounds with necessary conditions; no new proof or universal-necessity conclusion. Primary assessments of Cecchinato, Gottlieb and colleagues, and Shepherd retain explicit G0/J/E grounds; mentality does not cover all living, and no new proof or full-theory necessity follows. Friedman and Kauppinen primary comparisons retain epistemic norms and noninstrumental cognitive value; the common ethical ground still needs scope justification, with no new proof or universal-necessity conclusion. Goodpaster and Benatar primary comparisons distinguish biological interests from independent ethical grounds; the two answers remain complete, with full-theory scientific necessity unproved and no new theorem or experiment. Vesper and McPherson/Plunkett primary comparisons distinguish practical indispensability, epistemic warrant and ethical content; no new proof of normative existence, G0 necessity or mathematical theorem is claimed.
